pattern: marks a dev server it leaves running
experience: In this fork every background shell keeps a Claude thread in Working until it ends. An agent that starts a dev server for the user and ends its turn without marking it leaves the thread stuck in Working with no completion notice.
rule: For work you leave running (a dev server, a watcher), call t3_background_wait with its task ID and waiting: false before you end your turn.

pattern: leaves a background deploy holding the thread
experience: A deploy ran in the background after the agent ended its turn. Automatic settlement after the merged PR detached the session and killed the deploy and its waiter, and its failed smoke check surfaced hours later. A job the agent will report on must keep holding the thread.
rule: Background commands and Monitors you start keep the thread in Working until they end, and their results wake you.
